tiein.heading: Get off this list. Start shielding your trades.
tiein.line: Every trade from a brand new wallet.

methodology: Cost figures are estimated from observed copy-bot fill behaviour against top-100 HL wallets by PnL over 2–9 November 2026. “bps per trade” is the median adverse drift, in basis points, between copied and matched uncopied bursts, controlling for coin, size and volatility. Dollar estimates translate those bps against the notional traded in copied bursts. Figures are estimates, not guarantees, and are updated each issue.

footer.risk: Shielding protects wallet association, not market or liquidation risk.
